content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect more than one ASi module to the same [product_name] device?

Hello, You can connect multiple ASi Slave modules, but keep in mind that each ASi module requires its own I/O addresses. If your [product_name] application already utilizes the maximum number of I/O addresses, adding another ASi module won't work since all addresses are already allocated to the expansion modules. Hope this clarifies the situation. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing whether multiple ASi modules can be added to a [product_name] device. The exchange highlights that hardware restrictions, specifically the number of available I/O addresses, may prevent additional modules from operating if the I/O capacity is already reached.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to expand their system's I/O by adding more ASi modules to their [product_name] device, expecting this to be possible without running into hardware or address limitations.
